items.title: What the Average Hides
items.topic: how a school can improve its average test score while some groups of students make little progress
items.benefit: average scores provide a simple summary that helps schools compare broad changes over time
items.challenge: the same average can hide large differences among classes, starting levels, or groups of learners
items.lesson: a useful evaluation should examine both the overall pattern and the distribution of outcomes beneath it
items.topicJa: 学校全体の平均点が上がっても一部の生徒の伸びが小さい場合
items.benefitJa: 平均点は学校全体の変化を長期的に比較しやすい指標になること
items.challengeJa: 同じ平均値でも学級や開始時点、生徒集団による大きな差を隠す場合があること
items.lessonJa: 評価では全体傾向とその内側にある結果の分布を両方見る必要がある

items.title: The Cost of a Free Service
items.topic: why a free community service can still be difficult to use when access requires time, travel, or complicated procedures
items.benefit: removing a direct fee can make an important service affordable to many more people
items.challenge: transportation, waiting time, paperwork, and limited opening hours can create hidden costs that affect users unequally
items.lesson: true accessibility depends on the full burden of using a service rather than its price alone
items.topicJa: 無料の公共サービスでも時間や移動や手続きが利用の壁になる問題
items.benefitJa: 直接料金をなくすことで重要なサービスをより多くの人が利用できること
items.challengeJa: 交通、待ち時間、書類、利用時間などの隠れた負担が人によって異なること
items.lessonJa: 本当の利用しやすさは価格だけでなく利用に必要な負担全体で考える必要がある

items.title: When More Choice Becomes Work
items.topic: the advantages and burdens created when people are given many options in education or public services
items.benefit: more choices can help people select an option that better matches their goals, schedules, and preferences
items.challenge: comparing many unfamiliar options requires time and information, so people with fewer resources may struggle most
items.lesson: choice is most valuable when people also receive clear information and practical support for making decisions
items.topicJa: 教育や公共サービスで選択肢が増えることの利点と負担
items.benefitJa: 目標や予定や好みに合う選択肢を選びやすくなること
items.challengeJa: 多くの未知の選択肢を比較するには時間と情報が必要で資源の少ない人ほど負担が大きいこと
items.lessonJa: 選択肢は分かりやすい情報と意思決定支援があってこそ価値が高まる

items.title: The Repair That Prevented Complaints
items.topic: why maintenance work can be undervalued when successful repairs prevent visible failures from happening
items.benefit: regular inspection and early repair can keep buildings safe and reduce expensive emergency work
items.challenge: when nothing breaks, people may conclude that maintenance spending was unnecessary because the avoided failure cannot be observed directly
items.lesson: preventive work should be evaluated against credible estimates of what would likely have happened without it
items.topicJa: 故障を防いだ保守作業が成果を見えにくくする問題
items.benefitJa: 定期点検と早期修理で建物の安全を保ち高額な緊急修理を減らせること
items.challengeJa: 故障が起きないと回避された被害が見えず保守費用が不要だったように見えること
items.lessonJa: 予防的作業は実施しなかった場合に起きた可能性の高い状況と比較して評価する必要がある
